II. Software Requirement Specification
1. Overall Requirements
1.1 Context Diagram
The APE (AI-Powered Examination and Programming Practice Platform) is a web application designed for FPT University IT students. The context diagram below illustrates the system boundary, external entities (terminators), and all data/control flows between them.
External Entities:
Student: The primary end-user. Students interact with the system to upload personal study materials (BYOS), configure and take practice exams (FE/PE), view results, request AI Mentor hints, track learning analytics, and manage their profile/wallet.
Super Admin: The administrative user who manages courses, question banks, AI configurations, system prompts, user accounts, and monitors system dashboards (traffic, API cost).
Google SSO System: Handles user authentication via OAuth 2.0. APE sends Login Initiation Requests and Token Verification Requests; receives Authentication Responses.
Judge0 API (Docker): The external code execution engine. APE sends Executable Source Code, Input Arrays, and Execution Constraints; receives Standard Outputs, Compilation & Error Logs, and Runtime Metrics.
LLM Cloud Service (OpenAI / Google Gemini): Provides AI capabilities. APE sends Clean Text Chunks, Contextual Prompts, and Generation Requests; receives Generated Practice Contents, AI Comments, Contextual Hints, and Vector Embeddings.
OCR Cloud Service: Processes raw uploaded documents. APE sends Raw Course Materials; receives Extracted Text Strings.
Payment API: Handles financial transactions for purchase credits . APE sends QR Generation Requests; receives Payment Status confirmations.
1.2 Main Workflows
The APE system operates through five (5) core business workflows. Each workflow is described with a PlantUML swim-lane activity diagram.
1.2.1 Data Ingestion & AI Gatekeeper
This workflow covers uploading, validating, and vectorizing course materials. Applies to both Admin uploads (system-level syllabus) and Student uploads (BYOS – personal materials).
Flow: User uploads file → OCR extracts text → AI Gatekeeper samples 1,000–2,000 tokens → Classify (is_supported) → If supported: Auto-Chunking → Auto-Tagging → Vector Embedding → Store. If rejected: Warning Notification.
1.2.2 PE (Practical Exam) Generation – Hybrid Validation
The most complex AI pipeline. Uses Generator Agent → Critic Agent (retry ≤2) → Judge0 Validation Loop (retry ≤2). AI is strictly forbidden from generating Expected Outputs — only Judge0 produces actual outputs.
1.2.3 FE (Multiple-Choice) Generation – Actor-Critic
3-layer architecture: (1) RAG Strictness forces AI to use only Vector DB knowledge, (2) Actor-Critic where Agent 1 generates MCQ and Agent 2 reviews distractor quality, (3) Structured JSON Output with schema validation.
1.2.4 Exam Workspace, Code Execution & AI Code Mentor
Students code in the Practice Coding Space (web IDE), submit to Judge0 for grading, and optionally request AI Code Mentor (max 2/session). AI Mentor provides conceptual hints without revealing solution code. Resubmission uses Overwrite (Optimistic Locking).
1.2.5 Knowledge Analytics & AI Study Advice
After sufficient practice sessions, the system aggregates performance data, generates Competency Assessment Charts per topic, and compiles personalized reports. The AI analyzes patterns to provide tailored study advice.

Description
As a Student, I want to upload my personal study materials (BYOS) so that the AI can generate practice exams tailored to my own documents.
Preconditions
1. Student is authenticated.
2. Student has sufficient credits for BYOS processing (or valid BYOK API key).
3. OCR and LLM services are operational.
Postconditions
1. Personal document is stored with visibility = "Private".
2. Text chunks are stored in Vector DB under student’s personal namespace.
3. Student’s credit balance is deducted for the BYOS processing cost.
4. Student can generate exams from personal materials.
Normal Sequence/Flow
1. Student navigates to BYOS Upload page.
2. Student uploads personal document file (PDF/DOCX/TXT, max 20MB).
3. System checks student’s credit balance against BYOS cost.
4. System sends file to OCR Cloud Service for text extraction.
5. System invokes AI Gatekeeper for classification.
6. LLM returns {is_supported: true}.
7. System performs Auto-Chunking and Auto-Tagging.
8. System stores chunks in Vector DB with visibility = "Private" and user_id = current student.
9. System displays preview of extracted content. « include » UC-02: Preview Extracted Content.
10. Student confirms upload.
11. System deducts credits from student’s balance.
Alternative Sequences/Flows
6a. AI Gatekeeper returns {is_supported: false}:
6a.1. System displays warning: "Your document does not appear to be an IT study material."
6a.2. Student can choose to force-process (at own risk, credits still deducted) or cancel.
3a. Insufficient credits:
3a.1. System displays: "Insufficient credits. Please purchase more credits to use BYOS."
3a.2. Redirect to Purchase Credits (UC-20).
Exceptions
4a. OCR failure: System suggests "Please ensure the document is not a scanned image with poor quality."
File format not supported: System blocks with "Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, TXT."
Business Rules
BR-05: BYOS processing costs credits. Cost depends on document size.
BR-06: Personal documents are private; only the uploading student can access/generate from them.
BR-07: Maximum 10 personal documents per student.
BR-08: Students with valid BYOK API key bypass credit deduction for LLM calls.

4.2.3 Security
Security Domain
Requirement
Authentication
All users authenticate via Google OAuth 2.0 / OIDC. APE issues a signed JWT (RS256) with 1-hour expiry after verifying the Google ID Token. Refresh token stored in HttpOnly cookie.
Authorization
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Student vs. Super Admin. All API endpoints verify JWT and role claim before processing. Unauthorized requests return HTTP 403 immediately.
Transport Security
All traffic over HTTPS (TLS 1.2+). HSTS enforced. No sensitive data in URL query parameters.
BYOK API Key Storage
User-provided API keys (BYOK) are encrypted at rest using AES-256 before storage in MongoDB. Keys are never logged or returned in API responses after initial save.
Code Execution Sandbox
All student-submitted code runs in Judge0’s isolated Docker container with no network access, restricted filesystem, and hard CPU/memory limits. APE never executes code directly on its own servers.
Input Validation
All user inputs (file uploads, form fields, code) are validated and sanitized server-side. File uploads are virus-scanned via OCR Cloud Service pipeline before processing. Max file size: 20MB.
AI Prompt Injection
System prompts are separated from user-provided content. User inputs in AI prompts are wrapped in explicit delimiters to prevent prompt injection attacks.
Payment Security
Payment webhook callbacks verified via HMAC-SHA512 signature. Wallet balance updates use MongoDB transactions to prevent race conditions. No card data stored by APE.
Data Privacy
Personal documents (BYOS) are stored in user-namespaced Vector DB partitions. One user cannot query another user’s private content. Admin cannot access student personal documents.
Audit Logging
All Admin actions (ban user, delete question, change AI config) are logged with actor, timestamp, and change description. Logs are append-only.
4.2.4 Scalability
Component
Scalability Strategy
Backend (.NET 8)
Deployed on Azure App Service with auto-scaling rules: scale out when CPU > 70% for 5 minutes. Horizontal scaling to max 5 instances. Stateless design – session state in Redis, not in-process.
Frontend (ReactJS)
Deployed on Vercel Edge Network (CDN). Static assets cached globally. No server-side rendering required. Zero cold start.
Database (MongoDB Atlas)
MongoDB Atlas M10+ cluster with auto-scaling storage. Connection pooling via .NET MongoDB driver. Read preference: primaryPreferred for analytics queries to reduce primary load.
Cache (Redis)
Redis used for: JWT blacklist, session data, recent AI generation results (TTL 1 hour), rate limiting counters. Azure Cache for Redis with 1GB tier.
Vector DB (Pinecone/Qdrant)
Pinecone Serverless or Qdrant Cloud – auto-scales index replicas based on query load. Namespace isolation ensures per-user BYOS queries do not impact system-level performance.
AI Call Throughput
LLM API calls managed via LangChain .NET with async/await and configurable concurrency limits. Model Routing reduces Tier 2 (expensive) calls to only PE Generator and Code Mentor tasks.
Judge0 Throughput
Judge0 API calls are async. Multiple test case submissions are batched per job. Retry with exponential backoff on 429/503 responses.
CI/CD
GitHub Actions pipeline: build → unit test → integration test → deploy to staging → smoke test → promote to production. Zero-downtime deployment via Azure deployment slots.
4.2.5 Reliability
Reliability Aspect
Requirement / Mechanism
Availability Target
System uptime ≥ 99.5% per month (excluding planned maintenance windows announced 24 hours in advance). Core exam functionality must degrade gracefully if AI services are unavailable.
Circuit Breaker
Circuit breaker pattern implemented for LLM Cloud Services and Judge0 API. After 3 consecutive failures within 30 seconds: circuit opens, requests fail fast with user-friendly error. Circuit retries after 60 seconds.
LLM Failover (Model Routing)
If primary LLM provider (e.g., OpenAI) returns 5xx or timeout: automatically retry with backup provider (Google Gemini) within same Tier. Failover is transparent to the user.
Judge0 Resilience
If Judge0 API is unavailable: queue submission request, notify user "Grading in progress, results will appear shortly." Retry queue with max 3 attempts over 5 minutes before returning error.
Graceful Degradation
If AI services are fully unavailable: Students can still browse existing question banks, view past results, and access analytics. AI generation features display "AI temporarily unavailable" with ETA.
Data Integrity
MongoDB write operations for Submissions use Optimistic Locking to prevent overwrite race conditions. Financial transactions (Payments, wallet top-up) use MongoDB multi-document transactions.
Backup & Recovery
MongoDB Atlas automated daily backups with 7-day retention. Point-in-time recovery to any minute within the retention window. RTO ≤ 4 hours, RPO ≤ 24 hours.
Error Monitoring
All unhandled exceptions logged to Azure Application Insights with stack trace, request context, and user ID (anonymized). Alerts triggered on error rate > 1% over 5-minute window.

Requirement
Detail
Data Retention Policy
User submission history retained for 2 years. Personal documents (BYOS) retained for 1 year after last access. Users can request data deletion at any time (right to erasure).
Localization
System UI is English-only in v1.0. AI-generated content follows the language of the source document. Vietnamese language support planned for v2.0.
Legal & Compliance
Platform is designed for educational self-practice only (LI-1: no real-time proctoring). Not intended as an official examination system. FPT University retains ownership of system-ingested syllabus content.
BYOK Terms
Students using BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) agree that API costs are billed directly to their personal API accounts. APE is not responsible for third-party API charges incurred via BYOK.
Open Source Dependencies
All third-party libraries used under MIT, Apache 2.0, or equivalent open-source licenses. License inventory maintained in project repository.
Browser Support
Supported browsers: Chrome 100+, Firefox 100+, Edge 100+, Safari 15+. Internet Explorer not supported.

II. Software Requirement Specification
1. Overall Requirements
1.1 Context Diagram
The APE (AI-Powered Examination and Programming Practice Platform) is a web application designed for FPT University IT students. The context diagram below illustrates the system boundary, external entities (terminators), and all data/control flows between them.
External Entities:
Student: The primary end-user. Students interact with the system to upload personal study materials (BYOS), configure and take practice exams (FE/PE), view results, request AI Mentor hints, track learning analytics, and manage their profile/wallet.
Super Admin: The administrative user who manages courses, question banks, AI configurations, system prompts, user accounts, and monitors system dashboards (traffic, API cost).
Google SSO System: Handles user authentication via OAuth 2.0. APE sends Login Initiation Requests and Token Verification Requests; receives Authentication Responses.
Judge0 API (Docker): The external code execution engine. APE sends Executable Source Code, Input Arrays, and Execution Constraints; receives Standard Outputs, Compilation & Error Logs, and Runtime Metrics.
LLM Cloud Service (OpenAI / Google Gemini): Provides AI capabilities. APE sends Clean Text Chunks, Contextual Prompts, and Generation Requests; receives Generated Practice Contents, AI Comments, Contextual Hints, and Vector Embeddings.
OCR Cloud Service: Processes raw uploaded documents. APE sends Raw Course Materials; receives Extracted Text Strings.
Payment API: Handles financial transactions for purchase credits . APE sends QR Generation Requests; receives Payment Status confirmations.
1.2 Main Workflows
The APE system operates through five (5) core business workflows. Each workflow is described with a PlantUML swim-lane activity diagram.
1.2.1 Data Ingestion & AI Gatekeeper
This workflow covers uploading, validating, and vectorizing course materials. Applies to both Admin uploads (system-level syllabus) and Student uploads (BYOS – personal materials).
Flow: User uploads file → OCR extracts text → AI Gatekeeper samples 1,000–2,000 tokens → Classify (is_supported) → If supported: Auto-Chunking → Auto-Tagging → Vector Embedding → Store. If rejected: Warning Notification.
1.2.2 PE (Practical Exam) Generation – Hybrid Validation
The most complex AI pipeline. Uses Generator Agent → Critic Agent (retry ≤2) → Judge0 Validation Loop (retry ≤2). AI is strictly forbidden from generating Expected Outputs — only Judge0 produces actual outputs.
1.2.3 FE (Multiple-Choice) Generation – Actor-Critic
3-layer architecture: (1) RAG Strictness forces AI to use only Vector DB knowledge, (2) Actor-Critic where Agent 1 generates MCQ and Agent 2 reviews distractor quality, (3) Structured JSON Output with schema validation.
1.2.4 Exam Workspace, Code Execution & AI Code Mentor
Students code in the Practice Coding Space (web IDE), submit to Judge0 for grading, and optionally request AI Code Mentor (max 2/session). AI Mentor provides conceptual hints without revealing solution code. Resubmission uses Overwrite (Optimistic Locking).
1.2.5 Knowledge Analytics & AI Study Advice
After sufficient practice sessions, the system aggregates performance data, generates Competency Assessment Charts per topic, and compiles personalized reports. The AI analyzes patterns to provide tailored study advice.

All screens must be fully functional on desktop (1920×1080), laptop (1366×768), and tablet (768×1024) viewports. Mobile (< 480px) is supported in read-only mode.

4.2.3 Security
Security Domain
Requirement
Authentication
All users authenticate via Google OAuth 2.0 / OIDC. APE issues a signed JWT (RS256) with 1-hour expiry after verifying the Google ID Token. Refresh token stored in HttpOnly cookie.
Authorization
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Student vs. Super Admin. All API endpoints verify JWT and role claim before processing. Unauthorized requests return HTTP 403 immediately.
Transport Security
All traffic over HTTPS (TLS 1.2+). HSTS enforced. No sensitive data in URL query parameters.
BYOK API Key Storage
User-provided API keys (BYOK) are encrypted at rest using AES-256 before storage in MongoDB. Keys are never logged or returned in API responses after initial save.
Code Execution Sandbox
All student-submitted code runs in Judge0’s isolated Docker container with no network access, restricted filesystem, and hard CPU/memory limits. APE never executes code directly on its own servers.
Input Validation
All user inputs (file uploads, form fields, code) are validated and sanitized server-side. File uploads are virus-scanned via OCR Cloud Service pipeline before processing. Max file size: 20MB.
AI Prompt Injection
System prompts are separated from user-provided content. User inputs in AI prompts are wrapped in explicit delimiters to prevent prompt injection attacks.
Payment Security
Payment webhook callbacks verified via HMAC-SHA512 signature. Wallet balance updates use MongoDB transactions to prevent race conditions. No card data stored by APE.
Data Privacy
Personal documents (BYOS) are stored in user-namespaced Vector DB partitions. One user cannot query another user’s private content. Admin cannot access student personal documents.
Audit Logging
All Admin actions (ban user, delete question, change AI config) are logged with actor, timestamp, and change description. Logs are append-only.
4.2.4 Scalability
Component
Scalability Strategy
Backend (.NET 8)
Deployed on Azure App Service with auto-scaling rules: scale out when CPU > 70% for 5 minutes. Horizontal scaling to max 5 instances. Stateless design – session state in Redis, not in-process.
Frontend (ReactJS)
Deployed on Vercel Edge Network (CDN). Static assets cached globally. No server-side rendering required. Zero cold start.
Database (MongoDB Atlas)
MongoDB Atlas M10+ cluster with auto-scaling storage. Connection pooling via .NET MongoDB driver. Read preference: primaryPreferred for analytics queries to reduce primary load.
Cache (Redis)
Redis used for: JWT blacklist, session data, recent AI generation results (TTL 1 hour), rate limiting counters. Azure Cache for Redis with 1GB tier.
Vector DB (Pinecone/Qdrant)
Pinecone Serverless or Qdrant Cloud – auto-scales index replicas based on query load. Namespace isolation ensures per-user BYOS queries do not impact system-level performance.
AI Call Throughput
LLM API calls managed via LangChain .NET with async/await and configurable concurrency limits. Model Routing reduces Tier 2 (expensive) calls to only PE Generator and Code Mentor tasks.
Judge0 Throughput
Judge0 API calls are async. Multiple test case submissions are batched per job. Retry with exponential backoff on 429/503 responses.
CI/CD
GitHub Actions pipeline: build → unit test → integration test → deploy to staging → smoke test → promote to production. Zero-downtime deployment via Azure deployment slots.
4.2.5 Reliability
Reliability Aspect
Requirement / Mechanism
Availability Target
System uptime ≥ 99.5% per month (excluding planned maintenance windows announced 24 hours in advance). Core exam functionality must degrade gracefully if AI services are unavailable.
Circuit Breaker
Circuit breaker pattern implemented for LLM Cloud Services and Judge0 API. After 3 consecutive failures within 30 seconds: circuit opens, requests fail fast with user-friendly error. Circuit retries after 60 seconds.
LLM Failover (Model Routing)
If primary LLM provider (e.g., OpenAI) returns 5xx or timeout: automatically retry with backup provider (Google Gemini) within same Tier. Failover is transparent to the user.
Judge0 Resilience
If Judge0 API is unavailable: queue submission request, notify user "Grading in progress, results will appear shortly." Retry queue with max 3 attempts over 5 minutes before returning error.
Graceful Degradation
If AI services are fully unavailable: Students can still browse existing question banks, view past results, and access analytics. AI generation features display "AI temporarily unavailable" with ETA.
Data Integrity
MongoDB write operations for Submissions use Optimistic Locking to prevent overwrite race conditions. Financial transactions (Payments, wallet top-up) use MongoDB multi-document transactions.
Backup & Recovery
MongoDB Atlas automated daily backups with 7-day retention. Point-in-time recovery to any minute within the retention window. RTO ≤ 4 hours, RPO ≤ 24 hours.
Error Monitoring
All unhandled exceptions logged to Azure Application Insights with stack trace, request context, and user ID (anonymized). Alerts triggered on error rate > 1% over 5-minute window.

Data Retention Policy
User submission history retained for 2 years. Personal documents (BYOS) retained for 1 year after last access. Users can request data deletion at any time (right to erasure).

System UI is English-only in v1.0. AI-generated content follows the language of the source document. Vietnamese language support planned for v2.0.
Legal & Compliance
Platform is designed for educational self-practice only (LI-1: no real-time proctoring). Not intended as an official examination system. FPT University retains ownership of system-ingested syllabus content.
BYOK Terms
Students using BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) agree that API costs are billed directly to their personal API accounts. APE is not responsible for third-party API charges incurred via BYOK.
Open Source Dependencies
All third-party libraries used under MIT, Apache 2.0, or equivalent open-source licenses. License inventory maintained in project repository.
Browser Support
Supported browsers: Chrome 100+, Firefox 100+, Edge 100+, Safari 15+. Internet Explorer not supported.
